Fiery coals and sulfur will rain down upon all sinners. Turns your enemies into a smoldering heap of... something.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Carbine

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 50 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Carbine Barrel, Extended Magazine, Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load modified Explosive Ammunition (100eb [Premium] per 10) that also functions as Armor-Piercing and Incendiary Ammunition. This weapon’s Power Rebuild cannot make Ricochet Attacks.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Carbine
Pre-installed: Carbine Barrel, Extended Magazine, Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
